- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}/credential-types` — The credential types the issuer grants, and the form for each
- `PUT /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}/credential-types` — Declare the credential types the issuer grants, and their forms (any member)
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers` — The tenant's issuers, newest first
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers` — Register an issuer
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/verifiers` — The tenant's verifiers, newest first
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/verifiers` — Register a verifier
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}` — One issuer, with its DID
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}` — Change an issuer's name, description or mediator (its DID stays)
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/verifiers/{verifier_id}` — One verifier, with its DID
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/verifiers/{verifier_id}` — Change a verifier's name, description or mediator (its DID stays)
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/mediators` — The tenant's mediators, newest first
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/mediators` — Register a mediator; the registry gives it its identity
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/mediators/{mediator_id}` — One mediator, with its DID
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/mediators/{mediator_id}` — Change a mediator's name, address or whether it is public (its DID stays)
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/mediator-choices` — The mediators the tenant may pick: its own, then the published public ones
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities` — The tenant's identities, newest first
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities` — Register an identity
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities/{identity_id}` — One identity, with its DID document
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities/{identity_id}` — Rename an identity (its DID stays; whatever acts as it keeps its own name)
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities/{identity_id}` — Delete an identity nothing acts as and nobody has signed (admins only)

## The credential types the issuer grants, and the form for each

`GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}/credential-types` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `issuer_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [CredentialTypes](/reference/api/schemas/#credentialtypes) |
| 404 | [`issuer_not_found`](/reference/errors/#issuer_not_found) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## Declare the credential types the issuer grants, and their forms (any member)

`PUT /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}/credential-types` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `issuer_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [CredentialTypes](/reference/api/schemas/#credentialtypes)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `types` | array of string | at most 200 |
| `forms` *(optional)* | map of string (uuid) |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [CredentialTypes](/reference/api/schemas/#credentialtypes) |
| 404 | [`issuer_not_found`](/reference/errors/#issuer_not_found) |
| 422 | [`credential_type_invalid`](/reference/errors/#credential_type_invalid): not in the catalogue, or not one a tenant issues; [`request_form_invalid`](/reference/errors/#request_form_invalid): not one of the tenant's forms, or for a type it does not grant |

## Register a mediator; the registry gives it its identity

## Delete an identity nothing acts as and nobody has signed (admins only)

`DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/identities/{identity_id}` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `identity_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 204 | — |
| 403 | [`not_admin`](/reference/errors/#not_admin) |
| 404 | [`identity_not_found`](/reference/errors/#identity_not_found) |
| 409 | [`identity_in_use`](/reference/errors/#identity_in_use): the tenant, an issuer, verifier or mediator acts as it; [`identity_signed`](/reference/errors/#identity_signed): its DID exists, and those who resolve it rely on it |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
